{{Quote|I've lost my wonderful pet durni, Peaches. I can't stand it. Please help me find him.|[[Carson Vance]]|<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
'''Peaches''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Durni]] that lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and was the pet of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Carson Vance]].

==Biography==
During the [[Festival of Love]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Vance and Peaches were present in [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], when Peaches went missing. However, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] soon found the creature and returned it to Vance.

==Behind the scenes==
Peaches appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
